verses.14:26: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةࣲ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارࣲ‏

meaning: The root جثث primarily describes something that is fixed in place, unmoving, or prostrate. It can refer to a person or thing that is cast down, lying motionless, or gathered together in a heap.
